findings.claim: Pi delivery paths contradict each other and re-open v1 cache bugs. TECH-SPEC Q7 appends instructions.md to systemPrompt in before_agent_start; ADR-0009 r6 delivers the compaction block via session_compact flag then before_agent_start once; PRD E11 says Pi gets no injected messages at all. A one-turn systemPrompt change breaks the prefix cache (v1 #598/#822), and the only other carrier (before_agent_start {message}) is a CustomMessage that Pi converts to role:user (#1263/#1264).
findings.evidence: pi-mono types.ts:1497-1500 BeforeAgentStartEventResult {message, systemPrompt}; messages.ts:162-167 case custom -> role:"user"; PRD-v2.md:165 E11; adr/0009:97; v1 commit 98025973 body: 'any change to it invalidates prefix prompt caching ... cache hit rates drop from 90%+ to ~18%'; 6207ed25: 'Pi rebuilds the system prompt fresh on every before_agent_start call'
findings.fix: State one rule: Pi appends only the static instructions.md bytes on EVERY before_agent_start (identical bytes, cache-stable). Name the carrier for the compaction block explicitly (it cannot be systemPrompt-once nor a custom message without violating E11/#1263); decide and record it in ADR-0009 r6 and mark E11 superseded.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 6207ed25 2026-05-09 're-inject routing block every turn' (#497); 98025973 2026-06-12 and 4ced18cb 2026-06-21 'stop mutating systemPrompt ... preserve prefix cache' (#598,#822). ORIGINAL_INTENT: keep dynamic data out of systemPrompt; static block must be present every turn. REGRESSION_RISK: inject-once loses routing from turn 2 (#497); dynamic append drops cache (#598). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: static bytes, every turn, no user-role message.

findings.claim: The release layout puts the Pi entry at pi/index.js with no package.json. Without package.json Pi only auto-scans top-level dirs named extensions/, skills/, prompts/, themes/, so pi/index.js is never loaded. TECH-SPEC §6.9 also names a different file (pi-extension.js).
findings.evidence: pi-mono package-manager.ts:2241-2269 (no pi manifest -> for each RESOURCE_TYPES join(packageRoot, resourceType)); :214 RESOURCE_TYPES = extensions|skills|prompts|themes; TECH-SPEC.md:364 '-e <build>/pi-extension.js'
findings.fix: Put the Pi entry at release:/extensions/<one file or dir with index.js>; keep only the Pi entry there (every .js in extensions/ is loaded, package-manager.ts:636). Use one file name in PRD §15.2, TECH-SPEC §6.9, ADR-0011. Add a live install test (`pi install git:...@release` then `pi list`).
findings.archaeology: v1 used package.json pi.extensions ./build/adapters/pi/extension.js (cm-main package.json:30-33); ADR-0015 drops the pi key, so the dir convention is the only path left.

findings.claim: Pi row says 'mutate input in-process / replace result in-process' but the ADR's tool-detection relies on Claude-only signals (agent_type, .claude/agents/*.md). Pi subagents are separate `pi` processes with a --tools allowlist; nested tool calls carry parentToolCallId. The doc does not say how the Pi extension learns whether ctx tools are callable in that process.
findings.evidence: pi-mono examples/extensions/subagent/index.ts:300,307 spawn pi --mode json -p --no-session --tools <list>; sdk.ts:286 allowedToolNames; types.ts:1766 getActiveTools(); types.ts:1199-1202 parentToolCallId
findings.fix: Pi row: case decided per process from pi.getActiveTools() (ctx tools present -> A; bash present -> B via event.input mutation; else C via tool_result content+structuredContent replace, types.ts:1478-1484). Add a GP3 golden + live check for a Pi subagent with --tools read,bash.
findings.archaeology: No v1 Pi subagent handling found (git log -S agent_type -- src/adapters/pi empty in cm-main). Not a v1 behaviour change.

findings.claim: Pi is a 'required' live E2E agent run with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Owner decision: no API keys for tests. ADR-0012 supersedes §6.9 but §6.9 still says [D] and GS2/§2 count Pi among 6 required agents; no keyless Pi path is defined.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:351,364; TECH-SPEC.md:35 GS2; adr/0012:4 'Supersedes: TECH-SPEC §6.9'; adr/0012:11-15 lists only Claude and Codex keyless
findings.fix: Mark §6.9 superseded inline. Define Pi in the keyless harness (Pi OAuth login via /login, or tier 2 with a written reason) or drop it from 'required'.

findings.claim: ctx_upgrade for Pi fetches into its own version dir and renames. Pi owns the clone at <agentDir>/git/<host>/<path> listed in settings.json packages[], and `pi update` does fetch + reset + git clean -fdx there. A second copy managed by ctx_upgrade either is not loaded or diverges from Pi's state: two install trees (#901).
findings.evidence: pi-mono package-manager.ts:1931-1941 updateGit, :1982-1986 git clean -fdx; spike-distribution-verified.md:24-25 install path; adr/0011:69 settings.json packages[]
findings.fix: Treat Pi as host-managed: ctx_upgrade prints `pi update git:github.com/mksglu/context-mode@release`, like Codex/Claude Code.
findings.archaeology: v1 #901 two install trees (map rows); keep one install tree per agent.

findings.claim: Pi tool-name row is left as 'in-process plugin registers its own names' with no name. Rule 2 needs the exact name per adapter row, and lint PR12 needs to know it. v1 used the context_mode_ prefix and had to normalise it (#624).
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:192,199-200; cm-main src/adapters/pi/extension.ts:540-543 'Pi namespaces MCP-registered tools with the "context_mode_" prefix'
findings.fix: Fix the registered name (bare ctx_execute recommended) in adapters/table.ts row for Pi and record it as [D] in §3.8 with a GP3 fixture from a recorded Pi tool_call payload.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY b7597092 2026-05-19 'fix(pi): normalise context_mode_ prefix and path->file_path for event extraction (#624)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: journal extraction matched CC names. REGRESSION_RISK: mismatch drops ctx_* credit in stats. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one name, from table, tested.

findings.evidence: pi-mono types.ts:333 'cwd: string' on ExtensionContext; tickets/spike-project-source.md:25 'our bridge: env from ctx.cwd'; cm-main extension.ts:454 cwd: process.cwd()
findings.fix: Pi row in the adapter table: project source = ctx.cwd per event (#1246 session workspace), never process.cwd().
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY ab73792c 2026-05-12 'resolvePiWorkspaceDir() rejects ~/.pi/ as project root (closes #545 partial)'. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: never resolve the project to ~/.pi.
